## Slorath (CR 18)

**XP** 153,600  
CE Gargantuan magical beast (cold)  
**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +25  


**Defense**


**AC** 26, touch 10, flat-footed 22 (+1 dodge, +3 Dex, +16 natural, -4 size)  
**hp** 340 (20d10+140)  
**Fort** +19, **Ref** +17, **Will** +10  
**Immune** cold; **SR** 32  
**Weaknesses** vulnerability to fire  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., burrow 10 ft.  
**Melee** bite +26 (2d8+15)  
**Ranged** paralysis ray +20 (paralysis)  
**Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  
**Special Attacks** paralyzing gaze  
**Spell-like Abilities** (CL 12th):  

1/day—*glacial storm* (as meteor swarm, but deals cold damage) (DC 21 half).  
3/day—cone of cold (DC 17), freezing sphere (DC 18 half), ice storm  


**Statistics**


**Str** 31, **Dex** 17, **Con** 24, **Int** 14, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 15  
**Base Atk** +20; **CMB** +34; **CMD** 48 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Awesome Blow, Gaze to Ray, Improved Initiative, Improved Bull Rush, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Quicken Spell-Like Ability, Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Focus (ray), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +14, Climb +20, Perception +26, Spellcraft +22, Stealth +14 (+24 in arctic environments), Swim +20; **Racial Modifiers** +10 Stealth in arctic environments  
**Languages** Common, Draconic, Giant  


**Special Abilities**


**Paralyzing Gaze (Su)** Paralysis 1d6 +4 rounds, 30 feet, Fortitude DC 22 negates. The save is Charisma-based. This is a gaze attack.  

**Paralysis (Su)** Alternately, a slorath can use its Gaze to Ray feat to release a ray of paralysis (range of 30 ft.) as a ranged touch attack. After using its gaze attack in this manner, the slorath cannot use its paralyzing gaze for 1d4 rounds and it is disoriented during this time (-2 penalty on attack rolls, saves, skill checks, and ability checks). The save is Charisma-based.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** cold hills and mountains  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** standard
